source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of social and civic participation (PDF 183-184).

blocks.text: Social media, online khabrein aur digital sarkari khidmat logon ko bakhabar aur shehri zindagi mein sargarm rakhti hain; rasai na rakhne wale aksar bahar reh jate aur jamhoori amal mein kam numainda hote hain. Pakistan mein e-government khidmat shehron mein aasani se milti hain, to dehi log hissa lene ya samaji khidmat tak pohanchne mein kam qabil hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Samaji aur shehri shirakat par digital divide ke do asraat bataiye (short question 4).
blocks.explanation: Rasai na rakhne wale online khabron aur awami behes se mehroom rehte, to kam bakhabar aur kam numainda hote hain; aur e-government khidmat, jaise online darkhwastein, aasani se istemal nahi kar sakte, to dehi shehriyon ke paas sarkari amal mein hissa lene ke kam raaste hain.

items: Shehri asar: kam maloomat, kam numaindagi, e-government tak kam rasai.
